thumbnailVariants.note: No thumbnail was deleted to manufacture a recovery sample.

cloudDiscovery.rootCause: downloadImageFromS3 returned Buffer.alloc(0), which is truthy; serve-upload therefore treated a zero-byte S3 object as a successful recovery and would have cached an empty file instead of continuing to the recorded source URL.

red.failure: Expected source recovery bytes but received an empty response while the route logged Recovered from S3.

fix: serve-upload only returns and caches S3 buffers whose length is greater than zero
downloadImageFromS3 treats zero-byte exact and basename objects as unavailable

conclusion: A real cloud S3 integrity edge was found without deleting data or spending credits. The local fix is verified; ADMIN-003 remains open until the exact main candidate is deployed and the naturally missing object recovers through the existing source fallback without caching zero bytes.
